  = note: [0540]/[0630]: zeroed needs a zero image for every field, and a pointer, slice, pointer union, function or atom set has none, nor does a distinct type over one; write the value with its fields, or, for a service's state, keep its references in the handle and only scalars in the zeroed state (D288)
